import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions import similarity

# Initialize Pixeltable
pxt.create_client()

# Get the docs table
table = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Add embedding column if it doesn't exist
if "embedding" not in [col.name for col in table.columns]:
    table.add_column(
        name="embedding",
        computed_with=pxt.functions.sentence_transformers.embed(
            table.content,
            model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
        )
    )

# Create vector index for semantic search
try:
    table.create_index(
        name="embedding_index",
        column="embedding",
        index_type="vector"
    )
except Exception:
    pass  # Index may already exist

# Perform semantic search
query_text = "climate change policy"

# Embed the query
query_embedding = pxt.functions.sentence_transformers.embed(
    query_text,
    model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
)

# Query for 5 closest rows by similarity
results = (
    table
    .select(
        table.content,
        similarity_score=similarity(table.embedding, query_embedding)
    )
    .order_by(similarity_score=pxt.desc("similarity_score"))
    .limit(5)
)

# Fetch and print results ranked by similarity
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{i}. Similarity: {row['similarity_score']:.4f}")
    print(f"   Content: {row['content']}\n")
